```{r models, include=FALSE, eval=params$run_models}
local({
# Grouped-binomial models; no pooled Fisher fallback for failed fits.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(data.table); library(lme4)})
out <- normalizePath(params$out, mustWork=TRUE)
data.table::setDTthreads(1L)
read_table <- function(path, select=NULL) {
  x <- fread(path, select=select)
  # fread infers logical columns from header-only files. Keep join keys typed
  # even when eligibility produces an empty population.
  keys <- intersect(names(x),c('CRE_ID','CRE_pair','CRE1','CRE2','motif_id',
    'sample_name','donor','set','CRE_class','TF_label','chrom'))
  for(k in keys) set(x,j=k,value=as.character(x[[k]]))
  x
}
write_table <- function(x, path) {
  dir.create(dirname(path), recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
  temp <- paste0(path,'.partial')
  on.exit(unlink(temp),add=TRUE)
  fwrite(x,temp,sep='\t',na='NA',compress=if(grepl('gz$',path)) 'gzip' else 'none')
  if(!file.rename(temp,path)) stop('Could not publish ',path)
}
fit_model <- function(d, fixed, random, id) {
  ans <- data.table(id=id,status='not_fit',n_rows=nrow(d),n_units=uniqueN(d$unit),
    n_fibers=sum(d$n_informative),OR=NA_real_,ci_low=NA_real_,ci_high=NA_real_,p=NA_real_,
    background_frequency=NA_real_,coaccess_frequency=NA_real_,frequency_difference=NA_real_,
    formula='',warning='',error='')
  if(!nrow(d) || uniqueN(d$set)!=2L) {ans$status <- 'insufficient_groups'; return(ans)}
  d[, set := factor(set,levels=c('background','co-access'))]
  d[, donor := factor(donor)]
  if(any(d$n_bound<0 | d$n_bound>d$n_informative)) stop('Invalid binomial counts')
  margins <- d[,.(yes=sum(n_bound),no=sum(n_informative-n_bound)),by=set]
  if(any(margins$yes==0 | margins$no==0)) {ans$status <- 'separation'; return(ans)}
  # Constant nuisance covariates contain no information and must not create rank failure.
  fixed <- fixed[vapply(fixed,function(v) uniqueN(d[[v]])>1L,logical(1))]
  if(any(vapply(random,function(v) uniqueN(d[[v]])<2L,logical(1)))) {
    ans$status <- 'insufficient_random_effect_levels'; return(ans)
  }
  numeric_fixed <- fixed[vapply(fixed,function(v) is.numeric(d[[v]]),logical(1))]
  for(v in numeric_fixed) set(d,j=v,value=as.numeric(scale(d[[v]])))
  form <- as.formula(paste('cbind(n_bound,n_informative-n_bound) ~',
    paste(c('set',fixed,paste0('(1|',random,')')),collapse=' + ')))
  ans$formula <- paste(deparse(form),collapse=' ')
  warnings <- character()
  fit <- tryCatch(withCallingHandlers(glmer(form,data=d,family=binomial(),
    control=glmerControl(optimizer='bobyqa',optCtrl=list(maxfun=200000))),
    warning=function(w){warnings <<- c(warnings,conditionMessage(w));invokeRestart('muffleWarning')}),
    error=function(e)e)
  ans$warning <- paste(unique(warnings),collapse='; ')
  if(inherits(fit,'error')) {ans$status <- 'fit_failed'; ans$error <- conditionMessage(fit);return(ans)}
  issues <- fit@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
  if(length(issues) || any(fit@optinfo$conv$opt!=0)) {
    ans$status <- 'convergence_failed';ans$error <- paste(issues,collapse='; ');return(ans)
  }
  if(length(attr(getME(fit,'X'),'col.dropped'))) {ans$status <- 'rank_deficient';return(ans)}
  if(isSingular(fit,tol=1e-4)) {ans$status <- 'singular';return(ans)}
  cf <- coef(summary(fit)); term <- 'setco-access'
  if(!term %in% rownames(cf) || !all(is.finite(cf[term,]))) {ans$status <- 'invalid_coefficient';return(ans)}
  b <- cf[term,1]; se <- cf[term,2]
  if(abs(b)>15 || se>10) {ans$status <- 'possible_separation';return(ans)}
  ans[,`:=`(status='ok',OR=exp(b),ci_low=exp(b-1.96*se),ci_high=exp(b+1.96*se),p=cf[term,4])]
  # Population-level predictions, standardized equally over units and then donors
  # observed within units; random effects are set to zero.
  prediction <- function(group) {
    nd <- copy(d); nd[,set:=factor(group,levels=levels(d$set))]
    nd[,prob:=predict(fit,newdata=nd,type='response',re.form=NA)]
    mean(nd[,.(prob=mean(prob)),by=.(unit,donor)][,.(prob=mean(prob)),by=unit]$prob)
  }
  ans$background_frequency <- prediction('background')
  ans$coaccess_frequency <- prediction('co-access')
  ans$frequency_difference <- ans$coaccess_frequency-ans$background_frequency
  ans
}

cre <- read_table(file.path(out,'cre_covariates.tsv.gz'))
pc <- read_table(file.path(out,'pair_sample_counts.tsv.gz'),
  c('CRE_pair','donor','n_informative','both'))
pairs <- read_table(file.path(out,'pair_covariates.tsv.gz'),
  c('CRE_pair','CRE1','CRE2','chrom','set_adjusted','set_pooled','n_joint_accessible','n_informative'))
mc <- read_table(file.path(out,'motif_sample_counts.tsv.gz'),
  c('CRE_ID','motif_id','donor','n_informative','n_bound'))
motifs <- read_table(file.path(out,'motifs.tsv.gz'),c('CRE_ID','motif_id','TF_label'))
labels <- motifs[,.(TF_label=paste(sort(unique(na.omit(TF_label))),collapse=';')),by=motif_id]
model_spec <- 'donor_only_unmatched_v1'
for(analysis in c('adjusted','pooled','autosomes')) {
  dest <- file.path(out,'analysis',analysis)
  dir.create(dest,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
  cache <- file.path(dest,'model_results.rds')
  if(file.exists(cache) && identical(readRDS(cache)$model_spec,model_spec)) {
    message('Reusing ',analysis);next
  }
  set_col <- if(analysis=='pooled') 'set_pooled' else 'set_adjusted'
  eligible <- copy(pairs[get(set_col) %in% c('co-access','background') &
    n_joint_accessible>=10 & n_informative>=10])
  if(analysis=='autosomes') eligible <- eligible[!chrom %in% c('chrX','chrY')]
  eligible[,set:=get(set_col)]
  write_table(eligible,file.path(dest,'pair_eligibility.tsv.gz'))
  d <- merge(pc,eligible[,.(CRE_pair,CRE1,CRE2,set)],by='CRE_pair')
  d <- d[n_informative>0]
  d[,`:=`(n_bound=both,unit=CRE_pair)]
  pair_result <- fit_model(d,'donor',c('CRE_pair','CRE1','CRE2'),'any_motif_double_binding')
  write_table(pair_result,file.path(dest,'pair_model.tsv'))
  write_table(d[,.(n_informative=sum(n_informative),both=sum(both),frequency=sum(both)/sum(n_informative)),by=.(donor,set)],
    file.path(dest,'pair_donor_summary.tsv'))
  c <- copy(cre);c[,set:=get(set_col)]
  c <- c[set!='excluded' & n_accessible>=10 & n_informative>=10]
  if(analysis=='autosomes') c <- c[!chrom %in% c('chrX','chrY')]
  # Presence and occupancy both use all deduplicated motif instances.
  presence <- unique(motifs[,.(CRE_ID,motif_id)])[c[,.(CRE_ID,set)],on='CRE_ID',nomatch=0]
  denominators <- c[,.(n_cres=.N),by=set]
  grid <- CJ(motif_id=sort(unique(motifs$motif_id)),set=c('background','co-access'))
  pr <- merge(grid,presence[,.(n_with_motif=.N),by=.(motif_id,set)],all.x=TRUE)
  pr[is.na(n_with_motif),n_with_motif:=0L]
  pr <- merge(pr,denominators,by='set',all.x=TRUE);pr[,fraction:=n_with_motif/n_cres]
  write_table(pr,file.path(dest,'motif_presence.tsv.gz'))
  m <- merge(mc,c[,.(CRE_ID,set)],by='CRE_ID')
  m <- m[n_informative>0];m[,unit:=CRE_ID]
  write_table(m[,.(n_bound=sum(n_bound),n_informative=sum(n_informative),
    frequency=sum(n_bound)/sum(n_informative)),by=.(motif_id,donor,set)],file.path(dest,'motif_donor_summary.tsv.gz'))
  ids <- sort(unique(motifs$motif_id)); results <- vector('list',length(ids))
  for(i in seq_along(ids)) {
    id <- ids[i]
    sub <- copy(m[motif_id==id])
    results[[i]] <- fit_model(sub,'donor',c('CRE_ID'),id)
    results[[i]][,`:=`(n_coaccess_cres=uniqueN(sub[set=='co-access',CRE_ID]),
      n_background_cres=uniqueN(sub[set=='background',CRE_ID]))]
    if(i %% 25L==0L) message(analysis,': ',i,'/',length(ids),' motifs')
  }
  result <- rbindlist(results,fill=TRUE);result[,FDR:=NA_real_]
  result[status=='ok',FDR:=p.adjust(p,method='BH')]
  result <- merge(result,labels,by.x='id',by.y='motif_id',all.x=TRUE)
  write_table(result,file.path(dest,'motif_models.tsv.gz'))
  saveRDS(list(model_spec=model_spec,pair_model=pair_result,motif_models=result),cache)
  rm(d,m); gc()
}
saveRDS(sessionInfo(),file=file.path(out,'R_sessionInfo.rds'))
})
invisible(gc())
```

## Question and definitions

The primary comparison is double-bound frequency among jointly accessible,
footprint-informative fibers. A CRE is bound when at least one JASPAR motif is
supported by a 10–80 bp FiberHMM footprint with block score ≥50, at least 50%
motif overlap, and containment in a same-fiber FIRE element. Binding at the two
CREs may involve different motifs. This does not test excess coupling beyond
marginal occupancy, and motif labels do not uniquely identify the bound protein.

Co-accessible labels use saved genome-wide donor-adjusted FDR <0.05, OR >1,
and observed co-accessibility above donor-adjusted expectation. Raw pooled
coverage ≥20 is applied first. Failed adjusted tests are excluded. All 31
samples and all chromosomes, including female chrX, enter the primary analysis.

## Coverage and missing calls

Missing FiberHMM records are excluded from occupancy denominators, never called
unbound. Consequently the estimated frequency is conditional on a recorded
FiberHMM observation as well as accessibility. The tables below quantify that
selection. Accessibility uses full aligned-block coverage and the same-fiber FIRE rule.

```{r coverage}
knitr::kable(read_result('coverage_retention.tsv'))
knitr::kable(read_result('coverage_distribution.tsv'))
c <- read_result('cre_sample_counts.tsv.gz')
missing <- c[,.(accessible=sum(n_accessible),informative=sum(n_informative),missing_tf=sum(n_missing_tf)),by=sample_name]
knitr::kable(missing)
ggplot(missing,aes(reorder(sample_name,missing_tf/ pmax(accessible,1)),missing_tf/pmax(accessible,1)))+
 geom_col()+coord_flip()+labs(x=NULL,y='Fraction of accessible CRE-fiber observations missing TF records')+theme_bw()
```

## Donor-adjusted double binding

All eligible positive and background pairs enter the analysis without matching.
Pairs require at least 10 jointly accessible and 10 footprint-informative fibers.
The model includes set and donor as fixed effects, with pair and endpoint CRE
random intercepts. Predictions set random effects to zero and standardize equally
across pairs and donors observed within each pair.

```{r pair-results, results='asis'}
for(a in c('adjusted','pooled','autosomes')) {
 cat('\n### ',a,'\n\n',sep='')
 p <- read_result(file.path('analysis',a,'pair_eligibility.tsv.gz'))
 print(knitr::kable(p[,.N,by=set]))
 model <- read_result(file.path('analysis',a,'pair_model.tsv'))
 print(knitr::kable(model[,.(status,OR,ci_low,ci_high,p)]))

}
```

## Motif-specific occupancy

TF-specific tests use all deduplicated motif instances, including nearby and
overlapping motifs, count a CRE–fiber only once per motif ID, and adjust only for donor, with a CRE random intercept.
CREs require at least 10 accessible and 10 footprint-informative fibers. A background CRE never belongs to a positive pair in the
corresponding analysis. Presence is reported separately. Nearby and overlapping
motif instances remain eligible for occupancy analysis.

```{r motif-results, results='asis'}
for(a in c('adjusted','pooled','autosomes')) {
 cat('\n### ',a,'\n\n',sep='')
 m <- read_result(file.path('analysis',a,'motif_models.tsv.gz'))
 print(knitr::kable(m[,.N,by=status]))
 print(knitr::kable(head(m[status=='ok'][order(FDR),.(id,OR,ci_low,ci_high,FDR)],20),digits=4))
 if(any(m$status=='ok')) print(ggplot(m[status=='ok'],aes(log2(OR),-log10(pmax(FDR,1e-300))))+
   geom_point()+geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(.05),linetype=2)+theme_bw())
}
```

## Interpretation and limitations

Effects are adjusted only for donor; differences in distance, accessibility,
CRE length, motif abundance, coverage, chromosome, and CRE class can still
contribute to the observed associations.

BH correction applies across successfully fitted motifs within each analysis.
Separation, singular fits, convergence failures, and insufficient groups are
reported without substituting pooled tests. Closely related motifs may describe
the same protein family. The autosome-only and pooled-label analyses are
sensitivity analyses, not independent replication. Shared fibers and CREs create
dependence; the random-effects structure accounts for repeated pairs and CRE
roles but is not a direct mechanistic test of TF cooperation. All CREs and pairs
come from the existing gene-window candidate universe.
